summary: FD_ED_TC_11_Intent | FAQ First | Then Case Creation | Intent Switch | Correct Routing | No Context Loss
title: Intent | FAQ First | Then Case Creation | Intent Switch | Correct Routing | No Context Loss
description:
Customer first asks an FAQ question about a disruption notification ("what does this notification mean?"), then switches to wanting compensation ("I want to claim"). System must handle the intent transition correctly, provide the FAQ answer, then seamlessly transition to case creation without losing context or re-greeting.

Prerequisites:
Customer received a flight disruption notification email; PNR: TCED11; 1 leg AC (YUL?YYZ); Delay 4 hrs; Code 42; APPR
